reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Mn-deficient CrCoNi is a subset of equiatomic CrMnFeCoNi and that Mn induces magnetic frustration suppressing the fcc-to-hcp transformation, whereas extensive literature shows the opposite: CrCoNi has higher stacking fault energy and less hcp transformation than CrMnFeCoNi, and Mn is known to lower stacking fault energy and promote transformation.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but it is based on a physically incorrect premise, so the test would not actually evaluate the stated mechanism as intended.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it contradicts well-established experimental observations and would misdirect research effort.
